# A datastar(...) framed route renders with the dedicated DatastarTemplateData
# type. It carries the base helper surface (no HX* helpers), and its name is
# overridable with --output-datastar-template-data-type.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

grep 'type DatastarTemplateData\[' template_routes.go
! grep 'HXRedirect' template_routes.go

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server --output-datastar-template-data-type=DSData
muxt check

grep 'type DSData\[' template_routes.go
! grep 'DatastarTemplateData' template_routes.go

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /count datastar(Count(ctx))" -}}<span id="count">{{- .Result -}}</span>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Count(_ context.Context) (int, error) { return 3, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/count", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if want := `<span id="count">3</span>`; rec.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
